kitDescription: Mary is a pure support healer with no damage skills of her own. Her Skill 1 automatically heals the single most-injured ally each time she fires the last shell of her 9-round shotgun magazine. Her Skill 2 boosts all incoming healing the team receives for 15 seconds whenever the team enters Full Burst. Her Burst heals the entire team for a large chunk of her own Max HP, and while the team is healthy (above 50% HP) it also grants everyone a DEF increase for 10 seconds.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: all four kit lines are either faithfully encoded (S1 lastBullet heal event, burst own-cast heal event, burst DEF 19.8/10s) or verbatim-unmodeled with a structural reason (S2 incoming-healing has no StatKey and no HP pool to scale). The S5 blind tests run green (11/11 + 2 documented GAP skips) against the shipped override, and the S6 blind override is behaviorally identical on every line — convergence is mechanical, and the divergences that matter (burstCast vs fullBurstEnter, lastBullet vs shotFired, dropped-vs-inert DEF) are each pinned by a discriminating counterfactual in the driver's own suite, including the B1-contention arm S2b flagged as live. Both heal magnitudes and the S2 line are honestly documented as unmodeled due to v1 scope facts (no HP pool), and every ⚑ (alliesLowestHp leftmost stand-in, lastBullet cadence dependence on datamined ammo/reload) carries reason plus tier. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the alliesLowestHp→leftmost stand-in and the magazine-economy cadence (ammo 9 / reloadFrames 111) are convention-and-datamine-dependent — if either field is wrong, the S1 recovery channel's frequency inherits the error directly; also the DEF line's 50%-HP gate collapse is only valid because nothing takes damage at scope lock.
